title: Console: surface quality gate results, block Apply on failure, link artifacts + override flow
creator: Paula Mendes
description:
Problem
Optimize can recommend batching/caching/quantization config changes that reduce cost but can cause output regressions. We now require quality gates before apply/promotion (defense-in-depth). Console must (1) clearly surface gate status/results, (2) block “Apply” when failing/required gates missing, and (3) provide a first-class path to view artifacts and request/track overrides.

Scope
- Add UI elements to Optimize recommendation details + config change review to show gate state: pending/running/passed/failed/overridden/expired
- Block Apply action if gate required and not in Passed or Valid Override state
- Link out to gate artifacts (eval report, prompt-set runs, diffs) and to audit log entry
- Provide override request UX: rationale, expiration, owner, evidence links; show “override requested” and “override granted” states
- Consistent behavior in both “one-click apply” and “apply via rollout” flows

Non-goals (MVP)
- No new eval artifacts viewer inside Console (we link to eval-harness artifacts pages + stored reports)
- No private/on-prem automation (manual workflow only, but UI must still display recorded gate runs if present)
- No redesign of the Optimize recommendations list; only additive status chips/badges and a detail panel section

UX requirements (from DES-611 + PM guidance)
1) Recommendation list row
- Show a compact badge next to each recommendation:
  - “Gate: Passed” (green)
  - “Gate: Running” (blue/spinner)
  - “Gate: Failed” (red)
  - “Gate: Required” (gray) when no run exists yet
  - “Override” (amber) when an override is active
- Tooltip text must include: gate tier (Smoke/Full), run id, started_at, and last updated.

2) Recommendation detail panel
- Add a “Quality gate” section with:
  - Status summary line
  - Baseline identifier (baseline config version / model family / GPU sku where applicable)
  - Metrics delta table (key metrics only; full report via link)
  - Links:
    - “View full report” (eval-harness)
    - “View artifacts” (artifact bundle)
    - “View audit log” (Console audit log event)
    - “Rerun gate” (if user has permission + gate in failed/flaky/expired)

3) Apply CTA behavior
- Apply button states:
  - Enabled when gate policy is NotRequired OR status=Passed OR status=Overridden(active)
  - Disabled + inline reason when:
    - status=Failed
    - status=Running/Pending
    - status=Expired
    - status=NotFound (required but never run)
- Inline reason copy (finalized in #eng-platform thread 1764713305):
  - Failed: “Apply blocked: quality gate failed. Review the report or request an override.”
  - Running: “Apply blocked: quality gate is still running. Try again in a few minutes.”
  - Required/not run: “Apply blocked: a quality gate is required before this change can be applied.”
  - Expired: “Apply blocked: gate result expired. Rerun the gate to continue.”

4) Override request flow
- Entry points:
  - “Request override” button visible when status=Failed/Expired and user has override-request permission
- Modal fields:
  - Reason (required)
  - Expiration (required; defaults 24h, max per policy)
  - Ticket link (required; Linear/Jira) for traceability
  - Evidence links (optional; eval artifacts, incident, customer approval)
- Post-submit state:
  - Show “Override requested” chip + pending approver list
  - Lock Apply until “Override granted” is returned by backend
- When granted:
  - Show override banner: “Override granted by {approver} until {expires_at}”
  - Apply becomes enabled; audit log link must point to override grant event

API / backend contract needed
- Console API must receive for each recommendation:
  - gate_required (bool)
  - gate_status (enum)
  - gate_run_id
  - gate_tier (smoke/full)
  - results_summary (topline metrics + pass/fail reasons)
  - artifact_links (report_url, artifacts_url) OR artifact ids resolvable to URLs
  - override_status (none/requested/granted/expired)
  - override_expires_at, override_approver, override_reason (redacted as needed)

Instrumentation
- Emit UI telemetry events:
  - optimize_gate_section_viewed
  - optimize_apply_blocked (include reason category)
  - optimize_override_requested
  - optimize_override_modal_abandoned
  - optimize_artifact_link_clicked (report vs artifacts vs audit)

Acceptance criteria
- Apply is blocked in Console whenever gate_required=true and status is not (Passed OR Overridden(active))
- Users can always access failure reasons + report links from the failure state
- Override request is possible from UI and shows pending/granted states without requiring manual refresh (poll or server-sent updates acceptable)
- All actions are RBAC’d (read-only users cannot request reruns/overrides)
- UI handles missing artifacts gracefully (show “Artifacts pending upload” + link to run id)

Rollout / release
- Ship behind feature flag: console.optimizeQualityGatesUI
- Enable for internal accounts in staging first; then limited beta cohort (per PM-481)

Notes / edge cases
- Multiple gate runs: show latest run by default; allow selecting previous runs via dropdown (optional for MVP; implemented if API returns list)
- Flaky runs: backend may mark as “Inconclusive/Flaky”; treat as blocking and provide CTA to rerun
- Timeouts: show banner “Gate run timed out” with link to rerun and to runbook

References
- Design: DES-611 Quality gates Console experience
- PRD: confluence/product-docs/requirements/optimize-quality-guardrails-gating-prd
- System design: confluence/product-docs/design-specs/optimize-quality-gates-system-design
- Policy: confluence/policies-and-process/change-management/exception-policy-optimize-quality-gate-overrides
comments: 2025-12-11 (Kenji Nakamura): Shared initial wire notes; recommend a single “Quality gate” card with status + primary CTA to avoid scattering information. Copy draft in DES-611 updated.

2025-12-15 (Chloe Martin): Backend can expose artifact URLs directly but needs a stable artifact routing host; proposing to return artifact ids + a Console resolver endpoint. Following up in ENG-3921 thread.
2026-01-06 (Dylan Brooks): Implemented status chip on recommendations list + details section scaffolding behind console.optimizeQualityGatesUI. Waiting on API fields from Optimize service (ENG-3921).

2026-01-13 (Marcus Lin): Security review notes: override request/grant must be permissioned separately from apply; audit log link must be visible to enterprise users. Ensure reason is stored but can be redacted in UI for non-admin roles.
2026-01-28 (Alicia Perez): Failure state needs a stronger visual affordance; added red callout + ‘View report’ primary link. Confirmed with PM that Apply remains present but disabled (not hidden).
2026-02-06 (Dylan Brooks): Added override request modal + polling of override status. Apply enablement logic: gate_required && (passed || override_granted && now < expires_at).

2026-02-18 (Paula Mendes): QA sign-off for limited production rollout cohort. Please ensure we log optimize_apply_blocked events; SRE wants visibility into how often gating blocks users vs backend block rate.
